sentences.text:
Ananda Karmakar & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 5
May, 2025
Item 05.05.

In The High Court At Calcutta
 No. 2025 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
 Ml Appellate Side
 08
Ct 22 Crr 4591 of 2024
rup
 Ananda Karmakar & Ors.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Ms. Jharna Biswas ... for the petitioners.

1 . 
This revisional application has been filed with a prayer for quashing the proceeding in connection with G.R. Case No. 788 of 2024 corresponding to Barjora Police Station Case No. 112 of 2024 dated 11.06.2024 under Sections 498A/ 323/ 406/ 506/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Section 3 &
4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, pending before the Learned Judicial Magistrate, 6 th Court,
Bankura.
2.

entities.text: Barjora Police Station Case No. 112 of 2024
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners has submitted that de facto complainant left her matrimonial home just within two month after marriage and a mutual divorce petition under Section 13 B of Hindu Marriage Act was filed at the instance of both the parties and all on a sudden after filing of that mutual divorce application, the instant FIR was lodged with all false allegation against the petitioners.
3.
After considering all the documents annexed with the revisional application, the same stands admitted.

4. Petitioners are directed to serve notice upon the State through the office of the Public Prosecutor of this Court and also to serve notice upon the opposite party No.2 through speed post with A/D and to file affidavit of service on the returnable date.
5. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners has prayed for stay of all further proceeding of the G.R. Case No. 788 of 2024.
6. Considering all facts and circumstances, the proceeding in connection with G.R. Case No. 788 of 2024 pending before the Learned Judicial Magistrate, 6th Court, Bankura.

be stayed for a limited Ananda Karmakar & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 5 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157062197/
1 period i.e. till 31 st July, 2025 or until further order whichever is earlier.
7. Let the matter appear in the Combined Monthly List of July, 2025 under the heading "Contested Application".
(Bibhas Ranjan De, J.)
